question: Which trains run from Jaipur (JP) to Udaipur City (UDZ)?

sql: SELECT t.number, t.name, a.departure, b.arrival FROM stops a JOIN stops b ON b.train_number = a.train_number AND b.stop_sequence > a.stop_sequence JOIN trains t ON t.number = a.train_number WHERE a.station_code = 'JP' AND b.station_code = 'UDZ' ORDER BY a.departure

question: How many minutes does overnight train 12315 take to travel from Jaipur (JP) to Udaipur City (UDZ)?
answer: According to the 2016 timetable snapshot, train 12315 departs JP at 17:20 on day 2 and arrives at UDZ at 03:00 on day 3, taking 580 minutes (9 hours 40 minutes).
sql: SELECT a.departure, b.arrival, a.day AS departure_day, b.day AS arrival_day, (b.day - a.day) * 1440 + (CAST(substr(b.arrival, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(b.arrival, 4, 2) AS INTEGER)) - (CAST(substr(a.departure, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(a.departure, 4, 2) AS INTEGER)) AS travel_time_min FROM stops a JOIN stops b ON b.train_number = a.train_number AND b.stop_sequence > a.stop_sequence WHERE a.train_number = '12315' AND a.station_code = 'JP' AND b.station_code = 'UDZ'
